rationale: A best balances the visible brief: a clearly playful girl-and-balls scene, banner-friendly horizontal composition, strong focal flow toward the balls, and a prominent readable logo without excessive visual congestion. B is more immediately vivid but busier, with cropped balls and competing effects. C is polished and legible but so tightly cropped that the broader play scene is reduced. D has excellent craft and the clearest multi-ball action, but its square format, oversized branding, and extra underwater elements weaken banner suitability. E contains a usable horizontal illustration, but the presentation-board framing is less production-ready and the single prominent ball fits the plural concept less fully.
uncertainty_notes: The brief omits required dimensions, exact tablet model/logo text, placement details, and the referenced samples. Preview margins and E's presentation framing may also differ from the intended exported artwork, so those factors could change the ranking.
